jei.tieredarsenal.info.cobalt_ore: Found in the Overworld from Y 32 down to Y -48, most common around Y -8. Needs an iron pickaxe. Smelt the raw ore into Cobalt Ingots - with Tiered Industries, pulverize it first for 2 dust (3 in the Ore Purifier) and smelt the dust.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.titanium_ore: Found deep in the Overworld, Y -16 and below, mostly in deepslate. Needs a diamond pickaxe. Smelts into Titanium Ingots - but with Tiered Industries installed it must go through the Alloy Smelter: 2 dust or raw ore + 1 Steel Ingot = 2 ingots.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.infernium_ore: Found all through the Nether in netherrack; glows faintly and survives lava. Needs a diamond pickaxe. With Tiered Industries: Alloy Smelter only, 2 dust or raw ore + 2 Blaze Powder = 2 ingots.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.aetherium_ore: Found only on the outer End islands (not the main island), in end stone. Needs a netherite pickaxe. With Tiered Industries: Alloy Smelter only, 2 dust or raw ore + 1 Superconductor Ingot = 2 ingots.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.dust: Made from ores and raw ores in the Tiered Industries Pulverizer (2) or Ore Purifier (3). Cobalt Dust smelts in a furnace; the others go into the Alloy Smelter.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.gated_ingot: With Tiered Industries installed this ingot can only be made in the Alloy Smelter - the furnace won't take the ore. Without Tiered Industries it smelts normally.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.upgrade_template: Upgrades the tier below in a smithing table: Iron to Cobalt to Titanium to Infernium to Aetherium. Use the template, the piece to upgrade and one ingot. Enchantments, names, trims and fitted modules are kept. Copy a template with 7 ingots and a stone block for 2.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.greatsword: Heavy two-handed blade: slow (attack speed 1.1) but hits hard, with the normal sweep. Copper, Emerald and Iron are crafted; Cobalt and up are upgraded from the tier below.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.dagger: Fast (attack speed 2.2) and light. Hitting a mob from behind does 1.5x damage.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.spear: Reaches 1.5 blocks further than a sword and doesn't sweep. Hold right-click and let go to throw it like a trident (1.25x damage), then pick it back up.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.warhammer: Very slow (attack speed 0.8). Every hit sends a shockwave: 40% of the damage to mobs within 2.5 blocks of the target, knocking them back. Never hits you or your pets.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.bow: Works like the vanilla bow with more durability and extra arrow damage at each tier, from +0 (Copper) to +3 (Aetherium).
jei.tieredarsenal.info.shield: Blocks like the vanilla shield with more durability. When blocking a melee hit, Titanium knocks the attacker back, Infernium sets it on fire and Aetherium reflects 25% of the damage. Cobalt and up are upgraded from a vanilla shield.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.armoury_workbench: Fits and removes gear modules. Power (Forge Energy) goes in through the BOTTOM only. Gear in the top slot, module below, press Install (10,000 FE). Press x to take a module off - free, and the module comes back.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.blank_module: The base for every gear module. 4 from gold, redstone and a diamond.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.tools: Pickaxe, shovel and hoe for every tier. Copper and Emerald are crafted; Cobalt and up are upgraded from vanilla iron tools in the smithing table. Tools take the Auto-Smelt and Vein Miner modules.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.crossbow: Works like the vanilla crossbow with more durability and extra arrow damage, from +0 (Copper) to +3 (Aetherium). Cobalt and up are upgraded from a vanilla crossbow.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.explosive_arrow: Explodes where it lands. Breaks blocks only when the mobGriefing game rule is on. Used up on impact. 2 arrows + 1 gunpowder = 2.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.fire_arrow: Flies burning and sets what it hits on fire. 8 arrows around Blaze Powder = 8. Picks up as a normal arrow.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.heavy_arrow: +1.5 damage and extra knockback. 2 arrows + 1 iron ingot = 2. Picks up as a normal arrow.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.quiver: Holds 4 stacks of any arrows. Right-click it in the air to pack every arrow in your inventory into it, or right-click arrows onto it like a bundle. When your bow or crossbow finds no arrows in your inventory, the quiver hands you its next stack.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.tool_belt: Holds 4 tools or weapons. Right-click them onto it like a bundle. Press the Tool Belt key (G by default, see Controls) to swap your held item for the next one on the belt.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.void_sigil: Use on a block in the End to summon the Aetherium Guardian. 300 health, a shockwave up close, homing shulker bullets at range, and it teleports after you if you run.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.guardian_core: Dropped by the Aetherium Guardian. The only way to make a Celestial Module.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.annihilator: Creative testing tool with no recipe. A hit deals 1,000,000 damage with no attack cooldown, and kills are credited to you, so drops and XP work as normal. Right-click to kill every monster within 32 blocks; sneak and right-click to kill every mob within 32 blocks except players and tamed pets. Never breaks.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.lifesteal: Heals you for 15% of the damage you deal. Fit it to any Tiered Arsenal weapon at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.

jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.knockback: Knocks what you hit further back. Fit it to any Tiered Arsenal weapon at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.

jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.bulwark: +10% knockback resistance. Fit it to any Tiered Arsenal armour piece at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.

jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.celestial: Weapons: +2 damage. Armour: +1 armour and +1 toughness. Fit it to any Tiered Arsenal weapon or armour piece at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.thorns: Melee attackers take 10% of the damage back, per piece. Fit it to any Tiered Arsenal armour piece at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.regenerati: Regeneration I while you are hurt. Fit it to Tiered Arsenal chestplates at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.swiftness: +10% walking speed. Fit it to Tiered Arsenal leggings at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.
jei.tieredarsenal.info.module.auto_smelt: Mined blocks drop their smelted result. Fit it to Tiered Arsenal pickaxes, shovels, axes and hoes at the Armoury Workbench. Fits once per piece. Slots: Copper, Emerald, Iron 1; Cobalt 2; Titanium 3; Infernium 4; Aetherium 5.
